Personality: Andgar is a quintessential Vlandian tough guy who stands out among the lawless veterans of the Company of the Golden Boar for his rare integrity and courage. Placing immense value on the spirit of a contract, he believes a mercenary's reputation is worth its weight in gold, and thus never breaks his word when carrying out a mission. Although he possesses an outstanding tactical mind and leadership ability, his impulsive nature inclines him toward resolving matters through direct force rather than far-sighted calculation. Neither merciful nor bloodthirsty, he rewards and punishes his men fairly without ever indulging in lavish handouts. In his eyes, the battlefield is his only true home, and crossbows and horses are far more trustworthy than the rhetoric of nobles. This straightforward and fearless character has earned him respect within the unruly company, though it also frequently lands him in danger due to recklessness—making him a professional soldier who holds fast to his principles amidst chaos.
Background: As a Vlandian veteran who felt lost in peacetime, Andgar ultimately chose to join the Company of the Golden Boar under the leadership of Torgud. Stationed at Alantas, this mercenary organization is notorious for lax discipline and vile conduct as a scourge of the countryside, yet within its ranks Andgar honed his superb crossbow marksmanship and command talent. He is not only responsible for the company's tactical deployments, but also sustains the livelihood of these desperadoes through his exceptional administrative and commercial gifts. Even though clan leader Torgud is known for his ruthlessness, Andgar chooses to remain loyal, knowing well that across this war-torn land, survival depends on the armed strength of the company. Roaming the battlefields of Calradia, he writes his own mercenary legend in blood and contracts, constantly searching for the meaning of war amidst a chaotic mercenary life.
